title: Name, Heart, Door, Book
label: ch:fa-name-heart-door-book
canDo: I can say name, heart, door, and book in Persian, and I can tell which of the four is inherited and which is a later Arabic loan.

payoff.summary: The chapter closes on ketâb, an Arabic loan, then runs all four words back to back — nâm, del, dar, ketâb — sorts them by vocabulary layer, and rebuilds the earlier name exchange the reappearance of nâm reopens.
